title: CBT Homework Log Weekly Time Spent Trend
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cbt:homework time_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(time_minutes) as avg_duration, max(time_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst time spent for CBT homework log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture time_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average time spent with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether CBT homework log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
